failure: Failure: Uniqueness and convergence are restricted to the stratified model. The source explicitly distinguishes this from general positive-noise nonlinear cellular automata, where counterexamples to universal uniqueness are known. It does not imply O(log N) convergence of the full q^(Nc)-state finite network in total variation.
interface: Interface: This is a local/fixed-observable result for countable sites, finite state alphabet, positive Haar-reset probability, uniformly bounded indegree and fixed finite level count. For multiple requested observation times, their prescribed separation must be accounted for separately; the simple terminal-time local mixing bound is not a global joint mixing guarantee.

claims.title: Countable stratified networks have a unique stationary law with uniform local convergence
